scope: Retirement of unsafe or misleading historical mechanisms, not removal of the useful root/manager use cases. Replacement migration and release qualification remain with the numbered owners.

decisions.decision: Retire implicit privileged activation through the systemmagisk filename. The maintained flow requires the explicit System Mode action and bound one-shot authorization; the legacy-filename regression is retained.
decisions.migration: Use the explicit qualified System Mode action. Renaming a ZIP must never grant permission to mutate system partitions.
decisions.validation: PR7A final build/artifact/ordinary matrix run 34476924390; PR8 host suite and exact Windows APK results, within their documented scope.

decisions.decision: Retire the historical debug-shell auto-grant. Default su-check-db remains required by the source gate; the exact Next Windows debug APK denied Shell before approval on both LDPlayer and MuMu, then passed explicit-policy root stress.
decisions.migration: Grant or revoke Shell through the manager policy. Lab bootstrap root remains an explicit vendor/adapter prerequisite; no published product may silently auto-grant shell root.
decisions.validation: PR7A final build/artifact/ordinary matrix run 34476924390; PR8 host suite and exact Windows APK results, within their documented scope.

decisions.decision: Retire the public production signing key and global signature bypass. Maintained default features require release signature enforcement, the artifact gate rejects forbidden public/debug release signers, and CI uses a disposable release key.
decisions.migration: PR10 supplies the owned signer and tested manager/stub migration. Retain the existing qualified manager until that path is available; never accept an arbitrary APK merely because it bears the old package name.
decisions.validation: PR7A final build/artifact/ordinary matrix run 34476924390; PR8 host suite and exact Windows APK results, within their documented scope.

decisions.decision: Retire globally disabled manager/stub signature checking; retain maintained release enforcement and the separately identified debug test flavor. PR7A all-ABI artifact/signer gates and hosted manager lifecycle are the foundation evidence.
decisions.migration: Use manager and stub artifacts signed by the selected owned key. PR10/PR13 must qualify signer changes and hidden-manager recovery; unsigned/repacked managers are not a supported bypass.
decisions.validation: PR7A final build/artifact/ordinary matrix run 34476924390; PR8 host suite and exact Windows APK results, within their documented scope.

decisions.decision: Retire blanket release obfuscation/optimization disablement. Both maintained release modules enable minification; CI retains mapping/native symbols and the built artifacts pass the inherited manager/stub tests.
decisions.migration: Use source and matching symbol/mapping artifacts for debugging. Release internals are not a stable reflection API; supported module/provider APIs retain their explicit compatibility contracts.
decisions.validation: PR7A final build/artifact/ordinary matrix run 34476924390; PR8 host suite and exact Windows APK results, within their documented scope.

decisions.decision: Retire false upstream identity. The selected code actually descends from official v31.0 and its source/artifact gate binds the upstream base, commit and version. This does not complete PR9 compatibility/protocol/build-info separation.
decisions.migration: Use the actual upstream base and source identity. PR9 must define the upgrade/compatibility fields for installations carrying historical 29999/31000 labels; never infer code compatibility from those labels alone.
decisions.validation: PR7A final build/artifact/ordinary matrix run 34476924390; PR8 host suite and exact Windows APK results, within their documented scope.

decisions.decision: Retire only the separate BIOMETRIC_WEAK manager mode. Its availability fallback could silently remove the requirement after enrollment/hardware changes. Preserve nonzero legacy settings as an Android-controlled authentication requirement; unavailable credentials, cancellation and lockout deny new grants.
decisions.migration: Mode 0 remains disabled. Every nonzero legacy su_biometric mode requires Android authentication; the separate weak manager biometric prompt is replaced. Existing saved grants remain policy decisions; new grants and policy edits require authentication when enabled.
decisions.validation: docs/manager-pr13.json and docs/manager-contract.md. PR15/PR16 retain physical-device, production signer and release acceptance.

decisions.decision: Replace historical module-action close/focus/auto-close variants with retained terminal output and explicit dismissal. Configuration changes preserve the session; process restoration reports interruption without replaying the action.
decisions.migration: The maintained action terminal keeps output visible until explicit dismissal. The older close/focus/automatic-close variants are replaced; do not rerun an interrupted action automatically.
decisions.validation: docs/manager-pr13.json and docs/manager-contract.md. PR15/PR16 retain physical-device, production signer and release acceptance.

decisions.decision: Retire original Full stable/R65/R66 channels as Next update authorities. Archived metadata and binaries cannot establish an owned current signing chain or a safe cross-package upgrade. Preserve the useful manager/root use cases through an explicit clean migration and the owned PR10 update service.
decisions.migration: Original Full stable/R65/R66 manager/stub channels are provenance, not trusted Next update endpoints. Back up first, restore the original full manager before changing lines, install the owned Next manager/core through the supported route, reconfigure app preferences, and hide afresh. No automatic cross-package or cross-signer handoff is claimed; PR16 owns production-certificate transition acceptance.
decisions.validation: docs/manager-pr13.json and docs/manager-contract.md. PR15/PR16 retain physical-device, production signer and release acceptance.
